agents.label: Requirements Analyst
agents.description: Ingests the Jira ticket, enriches with Confluence + Lucidchart, classifies the webhook type.

agents.label: Webhook Designer
agents.description: Produces the full webhook design and posts it to the Jira ticket as a comment.

agents.label: Scaffold Engineer
agents.description: Creates the GitHub branch and generates the typed Python webhook scaffold + test skeleton.

agents.label: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Runs AI code review against Sapio standards and raises the GitHub PR.

agents.label: Test Engineer
agents.description: Generates the full pytest suite from design scenarios and reports coverage.

agents.label: UAT Packager
agents.description: Produces the UAT test script, promotes the Jira ticket, and tags the GitHub release.
